tracking_rule: A done task needs implementation and linked verification evidence. Edit this file and regenerate HTML/CSV; do not edit generated outputs as the source of truth.

milestones.title: Native prototype and Rust baseline
milestones.gate: Native shell, text/DPI/keyboard/accessibility and graphics evaluated; SQLite builds; GUI ADR reviewed.

milestones.title: Model, commands, history and storage
milestones.gate: Headless invariants, atomic edits, roundtrip, failure recovery and stale-result handling pass.

milestones.title: Complete class-modeling workflow
milestones.gate: Customer/Order/PreferredCustomer acceptance walkthrough works through the native GUI.

milestones.title: Reliability, usability and packaging
milestones.gate: Export, recovery, accessibility, release measurements and clean-machine distribution checks pass.

milestones.title: Flowchart and Use Case adapters
milestones.gate: Two adapters reuse document, scene, storage and history without duplicating the application.

milestones.title: Specialized modeling families
milestones.gate: Each accepted family has a declared subset and complete native/undo/roundtrip/export fixtures.

milestones.title: Broader suite proposals
milestones.gate: Each accepted capability has a separate scoped design before implementation.

tasks.title: Create reproducible Cargo workspace
tasks.deliverable: Four minimal crate boundaries, pinned compiler, Cargo.lock, inherited lints and run instructions
tasks.acceptance: Check, fmt and a minimal documented library test pass; no accidental GUI/SQL dependency in core.

tasks.title: Run the native egui shell
tasks.deliverable: Toolbar, sidebar, inspector and selectable class preview
tasks.acceptance: Debug and release builds launch on Windows; adapter failures have useful diagnostics.

tasks.title: Verify native storage build prerequisites
tasks.deliverable: Bundled rusqlite compile/link and temporary database smoke check
tasks.acceptance: Temporary write/read closes cleanly; no separately installed SQLite runtime required by that test.

tasks.title: Validate GUI text, focus and accessibility
tasks.deliverable: Native English/Arabic/mixed text, IME, keyboard, screen-reader/object-list and DPI matrix
tasks.acceptance: Essential input/navigation works or a documented GUI reconsideration blocks the gate.

tasks.title: Review the native foundation gate
tasks.deliverable: Prototype evidence and updated GUI/toolchain ADR
tasks.acceptance: Framework decision is supported by real behavior; no hidden prerequisite or essential text failure remains.

tasks.title: Define typed IDs and document records
tasks.deliverable: Classes/members/relations, diagrams/views, finite geometry and explicit ordering
tasks.acceptance: Model IDs and view IDs cannot be interchanged; checked construction rejects invalid geometry.

tasks.title: Implement domain and relation validation
tasks.deliverable: Reference, ownership, association and generalization checks
tasks.acceptance: Invalid references, self-generalization and cycles produce typed errors without edits.

tasks.title: Apply reversible command transactions
tasks.deliverable: Command enum, validated ChangeSet and inverse patches
tasks.acceptance: Compound creation/removal is atomic; a failed command preserves the previous document.

tasks.title: Add history and saved-state identities
tasks.deliverable: Undo/redo, SessionId, Revision, StateId and bounded history
tasks.acceptance: Undo returns to the correct semantic state; saved-state tracking survives undo/redo and branching.

tasks.title: Validate persistence DTOs and schema v1
tasks.deliverable: Independent versioned SQLite schema and checked load adapter
tasks.acceptance: Malformed/newer unsupported inputs do not enter live state or get rewritten silently.

tasks.title: Implement transactional save and publication
tasks.deliverable: Existing-file transaction, safe initial/Save As publication, migration and recovery foundations
tasks.acceptance: Injected write/publication errors preserve previous committed data and return typed causes.

tasks.title: Define bounded worker job protocol
tasks.deliverable: Owned snapshots, SaveRequestId and worker-owned connection
tasks.acceptance: Old session/revision results cannot clear new edits; pending work is bounded and orderly.

tasks.title: Pass headless foundation fixtures
tasks.deliverable: Command, multi-view, storage-failure and roundtrip evidence
tasks.acceptance: Reference invariants pass through public APIs without starting the GUI.

tasks.title: Build shared scene and picking geometry
tasks.deliverable: Transforms, text measurement boundary, shapes, polylines, labels and hit regions
tasks.acceptance: Coordinate roundtrips and picking order remain correct at supported zoom/DPI values.

tasks.title: Implement gesture preview state machine
tasks.deliverable: Select/pan/marquee/move/resize/connect/text states
tasks.acceptance: Release commits once; Escape and capture loss discard previews without semantic mutation.

tasks.title: Wire project navigation and editor session
tasks.deliverable: Diagrams/Model sidebar, name search, tabs, selection and inspector context
tasks.acceptance: Opening/selecting objects stays consistent across sidebar, canvas and inspector.

tasks.title: Deliver class and member editing
tasks.deliverable: Class placement, inline names, ordered attributes/operations and typed inspector drafts
tasks.acceptance: User edits create one semantic command; text editing does not invoke canvas shortcuts.

tasks.title: Deliver relations and attached routes
tasks.deliverable: Association/generalization tools, role/multiplicity and basic routing/anchors
tasks.acceptance: Relations follow moved/resized views and reject invalid endpoints without partial state.

tasks.title: Expose reuse and duplication explicitly
tasks.deliverable: Show in diagram, Duplicate model and model/appearance scope
tasks.acceptance: Shared rename affects both views; geometry/style remains view-local; duplication uses new IDs.

tasks.title: Integrate command history with native actions
tasks.deliverable: Undo/redo and dirty-state feedback across gestures/member/relation/reuse edits
tasks.acceptance: One undo reverses one user action while preserving references and normal text undo.

tasks.title: Pass the class vertical-slice walkthrough
tasks.deliverable: Native Customer/Order/PreferredCustomer fixture and saved/reopened evidence
tasks.acceptance: Names, members, inheritance, multiplicity, views, routes and identity match after reopen.

tasks.title: Export SVG from the shared scene
tasks.deliverable: Escaped SVG with bounds, labels, members and arrowheads
tasks.acceptance: Output parses and renders the declared subset without editor handles; font limits documented.

tasks.title: Polish shared editing and history limits
tasks.deliverable: Multi-selection, alignment/basic grouping/styles and memory-bounded history feedback
tasks.acceptance: Compound edits undo coherently; history eviction drops whole entries and never breaks references.

tasks.title: Finish save, close and recovery UX
tasks.deliverable: Save As, explicit errors, autosave snapshots and close/recovery choices
tasks.acceptance: Failed saves keep dirty work and previous data; cancellation does not lose the project.

tasks.title: Pass complete native usability checks
tasks.deliverable: Keyboard/text/IME/accessibility/DPI tests and representative task observations
tasks.acceptance: Results and gaps are recorded; no unsupported claims of easier use.

tasks.title: Profile release workloads
tasks.deliverable: Recorded baseline/medium fixtures, frame/save/load/memory and idle measurements
tasks.acceptance: Measured hotspots guide any optimization; proposed budgets are distinguished from passed results.

tasks.title: Validate Windows distribution
tasks.deliverable: Release artifact, notices, run guide and clean-machine smoke matrix
tasks.acceptance: Supported target runs without developer tools; graphics/runtime requirements are explicit.

tasks.title: Approve the basic v0.1 release gate
tasks.deliverable: Passed checks, native scenario, known limitations and reproducible release record
tasks.acceptance: No known data-loss bug; defined class scope, recovery and SVG workflows all pass.

tasks.title: Add Flowchart notation
tasks.deliverable: Typed shapes/flows, palette, inspector, constraints and fixtures
tasks.acceptance: Meaningful native workflow passes reuse/undo/roundtrip/export checks.

tasks.title: Add Use Case notation
tasks.deliverable: Actors/use cases, declared relation subset and fixtures
tasks.acceptance: Connections and editing rules are explicit; shared engine infrastructure is reused.

tasks.title: Review real notation reuse
tasks.deliverable: Cross-notation regression and focused abstraction review
tasks.acceptance: No duplicated file/history/session stack; abstractions reflect demonstrated common decisions.

tasks.title: Deliver an ER modeling subset
tasks.deliverable: Entities/columns/keys/cardinality and complete declared workflow
tasks.acceptance: Typed schema and visual compartments remain consistent through edits, undo and storage.

tasks.title: Deliver Activity and State subsets
tasks.deliverable: Separate constrained activity/state schemas and interaction policies
tasks.acceptance: Containment and transitions have meaningful native and roundtrip fixtures.

tasks.title: Scope and deliver Requirements/SysML adapters
tasks.deliverable: Declared requirements/block/port/constraint subsets and traceability rules
tasks.acceptance: Accepted adapters have typed semantics; no blanket full-standard parity claim.

tasks.title: Deliver dedicated Sequence editing
tasks.deliverable: Lifelines, message order, activations, fragments and temporal interaction strategy
tasks.acceptance: Insertion/reordering and numbering preserve semantics through undo/save/export.

tasks.title: Review specialized-family release gates
tasks.deliverable: Family-specific acceptance evidence and updated schema/compatibility policy
tasks.acceptance: Each delivered family is a working domain workflow, not only a visible palette.

tasks.title: Propose interchange and richer output epics
tasks.deliverable: Separate designs for accepted PNG/PDF/report/VP XML compatibility work
tasks.acceptance: Input/output, field preservation, fixtures and compatibility limits are approved before coding.

tasks.title: Propose remaining notation and engineering scope
tasks.deliverable: Prioritized selections from the 101-type inventory plus code/DB tooling proposals
tasks.acceptance: No implicit promise to implement every constant; each chosen epic has an outcome and effect boundary.

tasks.title: Propose collaboration and extension architecture
tasks.deliverable: Requirements for versioned automation/plugin boundary and collaboration mode
tasks.acceptance: Concurrency/merge/identity and runtime extension contracts are designed separately from the local app.
